description: Source file implementing functions to retrieve network interface addresses and related utilities for Linux, including IPv4 and IPv6 address handling, interface matching, and address scope considerations.

methods.name: IsAnyAddress
methods.description: Checks if the given socket address is an 'any' address (0.0.0.0 for IPv4, :: for IPv6).

methods.name: CopyIntoObjectFromArray
methods.description: Copies data from a byte array into a specified type.

methods.name: GetPotentialMatch
methods.description: Retrieves the interface address from a sockaddr structure for IPv4 or IPv6.

methods.name: GetNetmaskForInterfaceAddress
methods.description: Finds the netmask for a given interface address, supporting IPv4 and IPv6.

methods.name: FindIPv4InterfaceIP
methods.description: Finds the IPv4 address and netmask of the first active, non-loopback interface.

methods.name: IsUniqueLocalAddress
methods.description: Checks if an IPv6 address is a Unique Local Address (ULA).

methods.name: FindIPv6InterfaceIP
methods.description: Finds the IPv6 address and netmask of the interface with the highest scope ID, excluding loopback and link-local addresses.

methods.name: FindInterfaceIP
methods.description: Selects between IPv4 and IPv6 interface address retrieval based on address type.

methods.name: FindSourceAddressForDestination
methods.description: Creates a socket, connects to the destination, and retrieves the local address used for that connection.

methods.name: SbSocketGetInterfaceAddress
methods.description: Main exported function to get the source address and netmask for a given destination address, or default interface if destination is null or 'any'.
